key: Clear Walnut's Console logs?

key: Run JavaScript on the current page and share the result with the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: header; the script text is appended after a blank line.

key: Share the selected resource URL with the Mac?

key: Clear Walnut's Network logs and Resource timings?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: clear network logs and resource timings.

key: Share captured Network and Resource details with the Mac, including full URLs and request errors?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: Mac reads network/resource details.

key: Save and apply the Network log settings? The next reload or navigation may delete retained entries.
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: change Network log settings.

key: Apply the Network log settings? The next reload or navigation may delete retained entries.
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: apply Network log settings without saving.

key: Save the Console log settings on the iPhone?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: persist Console log settings.

key: Save the Network log settings on the iPhone?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: persist Network log settings.

key: Share the selected request and response headers with the Mac?

key: Share the selected request body with the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: read the request body of a captured request.

key: Share the selected response body with the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: read the response body of a captured request.

key: Share the selected request's cURL command with the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: copy-as-cURL of a captured request.

key: Share the selected request details with the Mac?

key: Clear all cookies in this WebView's data store?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: clear every cookie.

comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: %@ is the page host.

comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first %@ is localStorage or sessionStorage (technical token), second is the page host.

key: Export all domains' cookies and WebView storage on the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: export storage including all cookies.

key: Export the active page's WebView storage on the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: export storage of the current page.

key: Inspect all domains' cookies and WebView storage on the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: view storage including all cookies.

key: Inspect the active page's WebView storage on the Mac?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: view storage of the current page.

key: Allow the Mac to add a cookie?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first line; domain and path lines follow.

key: Allow the Mac to edit a cookie?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first line; domain and path lines follow.

key: Allow the Mac to remove a cookie?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first line; domain and path lines follow.

key: Allow the Mac to add a %@ entry for %@?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first %@ is localStorage or sessionStorage, second is the host.

key: Allow the Mac to edit a %@ entry for %@?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first %@ is localStorage or sessionStorage, second is the host.

key: Allow the Mac to remove a %@ entry for %@?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt: first %@ is localStorage or sessionStorage, second is the host.

key: Domain: %@ and its subdomains where WebKit allows
comment: Cookie approval detail line; %@ is a cookie domain.

key: Domain: %@ (host only)
comment: Cookie approval detail line; %@ is the page host.

key: Path: %@
comment: Cookie approval detail line; %@ is a cookie path.

key: Domain: exactly %@
comment: Cookie approval detail line; %@ is the exact cookie domain to match.

key: Domain: matching %@
comment: Cookie approval detail line; %@ is the page host that cookies are matched against.

key: Path: any, if only one matches
comment: Cookie approval detail line: no path given, so any path is accepted if exactly one cookie matches.
